Definition: Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kemuel = "raised of God"; 1) son of Nahor by Milcah and father of Aram; 2) son of Shiphtan, prince of the tribe of Ephraim, and one of the 12 men selected to apportion the promised land between the tribes; 3) Levite, father of Hashabiah, prince of the tribe in the time of David
